summary: Frontend-only testing of the static AMJ site (9 routes). All routes return 200, redirect works (/poesie -> /poesie/), no console errors, no forbidden CDN/wp-content requests, theme toggle persists in localStorage 'amj-theme', mobile burger opens sheet, dropdown menu shows Livres/Expositions/Poésies visuelles & auditives/Revue Textuerre, contact form submits and internal logic contains mailto: with anne-marie.jeanjean5@orange.fr, poesie audio triggers request to LOCAL /media/2023/08/*.mp3 (HTTP 200), livres book cover opens detail modal, actualites shows year sections (2024,2023,2022,2020,2019...), SDV data loaded (19 items). One broken remote image on homepage.

ui_bugs.issue: Broken remote image request to https://unsplash.com/photos/GdCR9_WMz_4/download?force=true&w=1800 (naturalWidth=0). Also violates the 'self-hosted assets' requirement even though unsplash is not in the explicit forbidden host list.

action_items: Replace the remote unsplash.com/photos/GdCR9_WMz_4/download image on / with a self-hosted local asset (or remove it) so no external image request is made and no is broken.
critical_code_review_comments: Homepage still references an external Unsplash URL. Self-hosting requirement should include ALL external images (not just wp-content/googleapis). Consider adding an audit step during build that fails if any is not a relative path or /media/*.

Audio playback uses a custom global player element instead of native <audio>/<source> tags, so a naive querySelectorAll('audio') returns 0. The requirement wording mentioned <audio>/<source>; while the functional behaviour is correct (local /media mp3 fetched, player UI works), consider using a real <audio> element for semantics/a11y/SEO or update the spec doc.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (13/14 checks pass; 1 broken image on home)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 routes tested via public preview URL https://amj-production.preview.emergentagent.com. Interactive selectors are data-amj-* (data-amj-toggle, data-amj-burger, data-amj-sheet, data-amj-nav) — there are intentionally NO data-testid. Theme is set via localStorage 'amj-theme' (persisted, verified). Audio on /poesie/ is a custom global player (not a native <audio> element in DOM); to verify audio requests, observe network for .mp3 after clicking a track button. Contact form submit path can't be captured by overriding window.location.href from evaluate context (Location.href is not overridable via defineProperty in most engines); instead verified indirectly (submit event fires, beforeunload fires, base64 dc-logic decodes to strings containing 'mailto:' and the target email). Livres modal opens on clicking the book <button> wrapping the cover.
rca of the issue: Broken homepage image: the source HTML/template contains an external Unsplash 'download' URL that isn't a direct image resource (Unsplash blocks /photos/<id>/download hotlinking), so the browser fetches 0 bytes -> naturalWidth=0. Fix: download the intended photo, place it under /app/site/dist/media/ (or /public/), and update the template to reference the local path.
